summary: Across this G70 corpus, sentiment is led by praise for driving dynamics, ride comfort, quietness, interior and exterior design, and technology appeal, while complaints concentrate on control and interface usability, connectivity and software issues, climate performance, dealership or service handling, and recurring feature malfunctions, with many service-style fragments remaining sentiment-undetermined.
limitations: A large share of the corpus is undetermined because many fragments are short service notes, procedural records, or incomplete statements without clear evaluative context.
Topics overlap, so they should not be added together or treated as independent counts.
Several clusters mix unrelated subjects or contain label-example mismatches, especially in service-note and keyword-driven topics, which limits how specifically they can be interpreted.
The corpus is overwhelmingly from one country segment, so smaller country segments provide insufficient examples for reliable comparison.
Some topic evidence reflects dealership, diagnostic, or administrative language rather than direct owner opinions about the vehicle experience.
